title: Return Merchandise Delivery Receipt Form
subtitle: Reconcile the promised return merchandise delivery with actual units, condition, custody, evidence, exceptions, receiving decision, and accountable handoff.
description: An original, fillable return merchandise delivery receipt form for controlling returned product, return authorization, and disposition unit through delivery receipt identity, observations, evidence, decision, exceptions, escalation, completion, handoff, and final verification without replacing applicable requirements or professional review.
use_case: Use at Returns dock, quarantine area, repair, restock, or supplier route when returns center, supplier, repair depot, or customer account owner and the delivering custodian need one receipt that separates physical handoff from inspection, hold, commercial acceptance, and exception resolution.

sections.title: Return Merchandise delivery receipt identity and routing
sections.guidance: Anchor the record to the exact work, parties, locations, and source references.

fields.label: Return authorization and original order number
SKU, serial, lot, package, or return-label ID

blocks.label: Responsible parties and route points

fields.label: Customer, store, field location, or return carrier
Returns dock, quarantine area, repair, restock, or supplier route

blocks.guidance: Preserve linkage to the return authorization, original sale, product identity, and return policy.

sections.title: Return Merchandise delivery commitment and receiving readiness
sections.guidance: Confirm what was expected, where it was due, and which controls governed acceptance.

fields.label: Return reason, warranty, ownership, and disposition control
Returns Center, Supplier, Repair Depot, Or Customer Account Owner

blocks.label: Return Merchandise delivery and receiving controls
items: Quarantine pending inspection
Data-bearing device privacy route
Hazardous or leaking item isolation
Temperature-sensitive return hold
Original packaging preservation
Accessory and component reconciliation
Supplier return authorization required
No credit before disposition approval
blocks.guidance: Confirm applicable controls before unloading, opening, moving, or accepting the delivered units.

sections.title: Return Merchandise delivered-unit reconciliation
sections.guidance: Reconcile each delivered identity and quantity before relying on totals or signatures.

blocks.label: Returned Items, Serials, Lots, Accessories, Packages, And Disposition Quantities received

columns.label: SKU, serial, lot, package, or return-label ID
Product, packaging, accessory, seal, and use condition
Return reason, warranty, ownership, and disposition control

blocks.label: Receipt totals and reconciliation
blocks.guidance: Authorized, received, accepted, and disposition quantity

sections.title: Return Merchandise condition inspection and receipt evidence
sections.guidance: Preserve observations made before the receiver changes packaging, custody, or physical condition.

blocks.label: Return Merchandise receipt inspection
items: Return authorization and original order identify the received item
SKU, model, serial, lot, and quantity match the approved return scope
Product and package condition are photographed before handling changes
Accessories, manuals, cables, keys, parts, or bundled items are reconciled
Tamper, use, installation, contamination, or modification evidence is recorded
Recall, warranty, ownership, and data-bearing status are checked
Hazardous, leaking, sharp, swollen, contaminated, or unsafe item is isolated
Temperature-sensitive item remains held pending disposition when control is uncertain
Restock, repair, supplier return, credit, or disposal criteria are not assumed
Unresolved identity, condition, safety, or policy issue is routed to qualified review

blocks.label: Receipt evidence index
blocks.guidance: Record only necessary proof and preserve privacy or security restrictions.

blocks.label: Condition, count, custody, and acceptance narrative

fields.label: Condition, count, custody, and acceptance narrative

blocks.guidance: Describe facts that cannot be reconstructed from the line table or evidence reference.

sections.title: Return Merchandise exception, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make the trigger, affected scope, immediate control, owner, deadline, and escalation reconstructable.

blocks.label: Return Merchandise exception indicators
items: No valid return authorization or item outside approved scope
SKU, serial, lot, ownership, or original transaction cannot be matched
Received quantity or accessories differ from the return request
Undisclosed use, damage, contamination, modification, or missing parts
Hazardous, leaking, swollen, sharp, or otherwise unsafe condition
Data-bearing device lacks approved privacy handling
Temperature control or product integrity cannot be established
Warranty, recall, return-window, or policy status is disputed
Customer remedy and physical disposition conflict
Duplicate credit, replacement, or return record is suspected
blocks.guidance: Select every observed condition; do not use a generic exception mark when the actual trigger is known.

blocks.label: Receipt hold, partial acceptance, refusal, or resolution

sections.title: Return Merchandise receipt decision and custody transfer
sections.guidance: Separate physical custody from final commercial, quality, safety, or financial acceptance.

blocks.label: Delivery and receiving attestation
blocks.guidance: Attestation confirms the recorded physical event, not waiver of a concealed issue or unresolved review.

sections.title: Return Merchandise delivery receipt closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: Use this return merchandise delivery receipt with the applicable customer commitment, carrier terms, site policy, and retention requirements. Do not infer acceptance or release from a signature alone; unresolved identity, count, condition, custody, or proof issues require an owner, escalation, and documented disposition.

blocks.label: Prepared, reviewed, and accepted

fields.label: Reviewed by returns, quality, or finance supervisor

blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated decision; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
